implementation_findings.provider_lifecycle: one provider per CERI provider batch
implementation_findings.client_lifecycle: one client per provider; reused within batch only
implementation_findings.ticker_cik_cache: in-memory per provider; reused within batch only
implementation_findings.http_cache: in-memory per client URL; reused within batch only

repeated_work.schema_limit: Only filings that previously produced persisted guidance can be known before HTTP. There is no filing-processing/document-hash ledger, so prior processing of zero-guidance documents is unknowable.

recommendation.reason: The fresh-provider repeat retained 100.0% of first-run filing downloads: all 407 accession/document pairs were downloaded and parsed in both runs, while the database could pre-identify only 112 guidance-producing documents before HTTP. A durable processing ledger (including zero-guidance outcomes) is the largest safe improvement because it removes network, pacing, parsing, heartbeat, and late dedup work without changing SEC selection or extraction semantics.

root_causes.evidence: 407 of 407 filing documents were downloaded and parsed in both A and B
root_causes.recommended_action: Persist accession/document processing state and skip known work before HTTP
